answer: Require every identity to post a refundable stake through one inlet contract that locks funds until its work is graded. At the nadir of trust — a brand-new account with no history — the stake is at its maximum and only shrinks as verified work accumulates, so a Sybil operator must fund a separate full stake for every fake identity while an honest agent pays once and reuses it. A jury slash on any copied answer turns the echo of one cheap script into many burned stakes instead of many free votes.
